rules.advice: Fever lasting more than 3 days requires immediate medical attention. Refer to the nearest PHC.
Give paracetamol, ensure hydration. If fever persists beyond 3 days, refer to doctor.
Rest, plenty of fluids, paracetamol as needed. Monitor temperature every 4-6 hours.
Diarrhea for more than 2 days, especially with blood or dehydration, requires urgent medical care.
Give ORS (Oral Rehydration Solution). Zinc tablets for children. Avoid spicy food. If blood in stool, go to PHC immediately.
Cold lasting more than a week may indicate a secondary infection. Refer to PHC.
Rest, warm fluids, steam inhalation. Avoid cold water. Use saline nasal drops if needed.
Rapidly spreading rash or rash with fever requires immediate medical evaluation.
Keep the area clean and dry. Avoid scratching. Do not apply unknown creams. If rash spreads or painful, go to PHC.
Persistent vomiting causes dehydration. Seek medical help especially for children and pregnant women.
Small sips of water or ORS. Avoid solid food for 2-4 hours. Rest. If not improving in 24 hours, visit PHC.
